info.title: Seed Audio 1.5 Video to Audio
info.description: Generate dialogue, narration, effects, and music in sync with a video. You can supply reference voices and retrieve the video with the generated audio.

post.description:
> 🚧 **This model is not yet available.**

- Generate dialogue, narration, effects, and music timed to the action on screen. You can supply reference voices and request the video with the new audio.
- Videos must be `4`–`360` seconds long. The generated audio matches the video duration.
- Include the exact lines to speak in the prompt. Generating only music or sound effects is unsupported.
- Processing is asynchronous. Use the returned task ID to [check the result](/en/api-manual/task-management/get-task-detail). Tasks cannot be cancelled after submission.
- Output links expire after 7 days. Save the files before then.

**Billing**

- Billing is based on generated audio duration, which matches the video duration. Fractional seconds are rounded up to the next second.
- At submission, `usage.credits_reserved` is based on the video duration, so your balance must cover that amount. If the video duration cannot be read, credits for the `6`-minute maximum are reserved. The final charge uses the actual duration. Excess credits are refunded and any shortfall is charged. Failed tasks receive a full refund.

**Task results when `status` is `completed`**

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| `results[0]` / `result_data[0].audio_url` | Audio URL. |
| `result_data[0].duration` | Audio duration in seconds. |
| `result_data[0].video_url` | URL of the video with generated audio, returned when `return_video` is `true`. |
| `result_data[0].subtitles` | Subtitles in the form `[{"format": "srt", "url": "…"}, {"format": "jsonl", "url": "…"}]`: download links to the subtitle files, valid as long as the audio links. Each line of the JSONL file contains one word and its start and end times in seconds. |
| `usage.billed_seconds` / `usage.credits_used` | Billed seconds and credits actually used, respectively. |

basic.summary: Generate audio for the scene and return the video

value.prompt: Synchronize the sound with the picture. Play a clear glass chime as a band of golden light sweeps across the glass. In the last two seconds, a deep male voice softly says in English, “Pure by design.” Speak only the quoted line.

value.prompt: Ring the doorbell when the door opens. Then use the voice from reference clip 1 to say softly, “Welcome back.” Lower the music during the dialogue.

prompt.description: Describe the sounds and when they occur on screen (for example, a doorbell when a door opens). Quote the full lines to speak and identify each speaker and language. If using reference clips, assign each clip to a character.
prompt.example: Ring the doorbell when the door opens. Then use the voice from reference clip 1 to say softly, “Welcome back.” Lower the music during the dialogue.

video_urls.description:
Supply one video to generate audio for.

**Video requirements**

- Use a publicly accessible URL.
- Duration: `4`–`360` seconds at `12`–`60` fps.
- Formats: `mp4` or `mov`, up to `200 MB`.
- Width and height: `300`–`6000` pixels each. Aspect ratio: `0.4`–`2.5`. Width × height: `407,696`–`2,086,876` pixels. `1280×720` and `1920×1080` qualify. `640×480` is too small and `4K` is too large.

audio_urls.description:
Optional reference clips for the narrator’s or characters’ voices.

- Supply up to `6` items (clips and voice IDs combined), numbered from 1 in array order. In `prompt`, assign each clip to a role (for example, clip 1 is the host and clip 2 is the guest).
- Each item is a public URL of a voice sample, or a **voice ID** written as `speaker://<voice_type>`, for example `speaker://zh_female_vv_uranus_bigtts`. See [Seed Audio 1.5 voices](/en/api-manual/audio-series/seed-audio-1.5/seed-audio-1.5-voices) for the available voices.
- Each clip must be `2`–`30` seconds long, up to `180` seconds in total (voice IDs not counted).
- Formats: `wav` or `mp3`, up to `15 MB` per clip.

return_video.description: Set `true` to include the video with the generated audio at `result_data[0].video_url`. The default is `false` (audio only).

format.description:
Output audio format

- `wav` (default) or `mp3`
- `ogg_opus` supports only `48000` Hz.
- `pcm` returns raw 16-bit audio without a header. Standard media players need additional processing to play it.

sample_rate.description: Output sample rate in Hz. For `wav`, `mp3`, and `pcm`, choose any listed rate (default `44100`). For `ogg_opus`, the only valid rate is `48000`, which is selected automatically if omitted.

speech_rate.description: Speech rate as an integer from `-50` to `100`. At `0` (default), speech plays at normal speed. `100` is about twice as fast and `-50` is about half speed.

loudness_rate.description: Volume as an integer from `-50` to `100`. `0` is the normal volume (default). `100` is about twice as loud and `-50` is about half as loud.

pitch_rate.description: Pitch adjustment in **semitones**, from `-12` to `12`. `0` (default) leaves pitch unchanged. `12` raises it one octave and `-12` lowers it one octave.

subtitles.description:
Include subtitles.

`true` returns download links to the subtitle files in both `srt` and `jsonl` formats in the task result. The default is `false` (no subtitles).

callback_url.description:
HTTPS callback URL invoked when the task finishes

**When it fires:**
- Triggered when the task is completed, failed, or cancelled
- Sent after billing is finalized

**Security restrictions:**
- HTTPS only
- Callbacks to internal IP addresses are forbidden (127.0.0.1, 10.x.x.x, 172.16-31.x.x, 192.168.x.x, etc.)
- URL length must not exceed `2048` characters

**Callback mechanism:**
- Timeout: `10` seconds
- Up to `3` retries on failure (at `1` / `2` / `4` seconds after each failure)
- The callback body has the same format as the task-query response
- A 2xx response is treated as success; other status codes trigger a retry

can_cancel.description: Whether the task can be cancelled. This model does not support cancellation after submission.

credits_reserved.description: Credits reserved based on video duration, or for the 6-minute maximum if the duration cannot be read. The final charge uses the actual duration. Any difference is refunded or charged.

bearerAuth.description:
All endpoints require Bearer Token authentication

**Get your API Key:**

Visit the [API Key management page](https://evolink.ai/dashboard/keys) to obtain your API Key

**Add it to the request header:**
```
Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY
```
